func TestRustParityCollectorOracle(t *testing.T) {
	initMetrics(prometheus.Labels{"cluster": "oracle"})
	initLabelValues()
	cmdDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	cmdFailedDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	internalCmdDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	internalCmdFailedDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	requestDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	TSOBestBatchSize.Observe(1.25)
	TSOBatchSize.Observe(1.25)
	TSOBatchSendLatency.Observe(1.25)
	TSORetryCount.Observe(1.25)
	RequestForwarded.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Set(1.25)
	OngoingRequestCountGauge.WithLabelValues("variable0").Set(1.25)
	EstimateTSOLatencyGauge.WithLabelValues("variable0").Set(1.25)
	CircuitBreakerCounters.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Add(1.25)
	QueryRegionBestBatchSize.Observe(1.25)
	QueryRegionBatchSize.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	QueryRegionBatchSendLatency.Observe(1.25)
	CmdDurationTSOWait.Observe(2)
	CmdDurationTSO.Observe(3)
	CmdDurationTSOAsyncWait.Observe(4)
	CmdDurationGetRegion.Observe(5)
	CmdDurationGetAllMembers.Observe(6)
	CmdDurationGetPrevRegion.Observe(7)
	CmdDurationGetRegionByID.Observe(8)
	CmdDurationScanRegions.Observe(9)
	CmdDurationBatchScanRegions.Observe(10)
	CmdDurationGetStore.Observe(11)
	CmdDurationGetAllStores.Observe(12)
	CmdDurationUpdateGCSafePoint.Observe(13)
	CmdDurationUpdateServiceGCSafePoint.Observe(14)
	CmdDurationScatterRegion.Observe(15)
	CmdDurationScatterRegions.Observe(16)
	CmdDurationGetOperator.Observe(17)
	CmdDurationSplitRegions.Observe(18)
	CmdDurationSplitAndScatterRegions.Observe(19)
	CmdDurationLoadKeyspace.Observe(20)
	CmdDurationLoadKeyspaceByID.Observe(21)
	CmdDurationUpdateKeyspaceState.Observe(22)
	CmdDurationGetAllKeyspaces.Observe(23)
	CmdDurationGet.Observe(24)
	CmdDurationPut.Observe(25)
	CmdDurationUpdateGCSafePointV2.Observe(26)
	CmdDurationUpdateServiceSafePointV2.Observe(27)
	CmdDurationQueryRegionAsyncWait.Observe(28)
	CmdDurationQueryRegionWait.Observe(29)
	CmdDurationQueryRegion.Observe(30)
	CmdDurationAdvanceTxnSafePoint.Observe(31)
	CmdDurationAdvanceGCSafePoint.Observe(32)
	CmdDurationSetGCBarrier.Observe(33)
	CmdDurationDeleteGCBarrier.Observe(34)
	CmdDurationGetGCState.Observe(35)
	CmdDurationSetGlobalGCBarrier.Observe(36)
	CmdDurationDeleteGlobalGCBarrier.Observe(37)
	CmdDurationGetAllKeyspacesGCStates.Observe(38)
	CmdFailedDurationGetRegion.Observe(39)
	CmdFailedDurationTSOWait.Observe(40)
	CmdFailedDurationTSO.Observe(41)
	CmdFailedDurationGetAllMembers.Observe(42)
	CmdFailedDurationGetPrevRegion.Observe(43)

	CmdFailedDurationUpdateServiceSafePointV2.Observe(57)
	CmdFailedDurationQueryRegionAsyncWait.Observe(58)
	CmdFailedDurationQueryRegionWait.Observe(59)
	CmdFailedDurationQueryRegion.Observe(60)
	CmdFailedDurationAdvanceTxnSafePoint.Observe(61)
	CmdFailedDurationAdvanceGCSafePoint.Observe(62)
	CmdFailedDurationSetGCBarrier.Observe(63)
	CmdFailedDurationDeleteGCBarrier.Observe(64)
	CmdFailedDurationGetGCState.Observe(65)
	CmdFailedDurationSetGlobalGCBarrier.Observe(66)
	CmdFailedDurationDeleteGlobalGCBarrier.Observe(67)
	CmdFailedDurationGetAllKeyspacesGCStates.Observe(68)
	InternalCmdDurationGetClusterInfo.Observe(69)
	InternalCmdDurationGetMembers.Observe(70)
	InternalCmdFailedDurationGetClusterInfo.Observe(71)
	InternalCmdFailedDurationGetMembers.Observe(72)
	RequestDurationTSO.Observe(73)
	RequestFailedDurationTSO.Observe(74)
	RequestDurationQueryRegion.Observe(75)
	RequestFailedDurationQueryRegion.Observe(76)
	QueryRegionBatchSizeTotal.Observe(77)
	QueryRegionBatchSizeByKeys.Observe(78)
	QueryRegionBatchSizeByPrevKeys.Observe(79)
	QueryRegionBatchSizeByIDs.Observe(80)
	collectors := map[string]prometheus.Collector{
		"cmdDuration":                 cmdDuration,
		"cmdFailedDuration":           cmdFailedDuration,
		"internalCmdDuration":         internalCmdDuration,
		"internalCmdFailedDuration":   internalCmdFailedDuration,
		"requestDuration":             requestDuration,
		"TSOBestBatchSize":            TSOBestBatchSize,
		"TSOBatchSize":                TSOBatchSize,
		"TSOBatchSendLatency":         TSOBatchSendLatency,
		"TSORetryCount":               TSORetryCount,
		"RequestForwarded":            RequestForwarded,
		"OngoingRequestCountGauge":    OngoingRequestCountGauge,
		"EstimateTSOLatencyGauge":     EstimateTSOLatencyGauge,
		"CircuitBreakerCounters":      CircuitBreakerCounters,
		"QueryRegionBestBatchSize":    QueryRegionBestBatchSize,
		"QueryRegionBatchSize":        QueryRegionBatchSize,
		"QueryRegionBatchSendLatency": QueryRegionBatchSendLatency,
	}
	snapshots := map[string]interface{}{}
	for name, collector := range collectors {
		registry := prometheus.NewRegistry()
		registry.MustRegister(collector)
		families, err := registry.Gather()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(families) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: families %d", name, len(families))
		}
		snapshots[name] = families[0]
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(snapshots)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var normalized interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &normalized); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stripCreationTimes(normalized)
	payload, err = json.MarshalIndent(normalized, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("PD_METRICS_ORACLE")+"/pd.json", payload, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func stripCreationTimes(v interface{}) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		delete(x, "created_timestamp")
		for _, child := range x {
			stripCreationTimes(child)
		}
	case []interface{}:
		for _, child := range x {
			stripCreationTimes(child)
		}
	}
}
